purpose: Genre-local reference expansion pilot for mix, instrumentation, technique, articulation, and pattern review.
sourceRule: Each style owns its evidence. A reference can inform multiple styles only when the performance itself demonstrates each style; neighboring genres are not substitutes.

storageGate.note: Maintain at least 5 GiB free. Keep retained references/review audio below 500 MiB and peak temporary audio below 1 GiB; check free space before each batch and separation. Three references per style is the requested baseline.
storageGate.forecastNewMp3sAtObservedMean: about 116 MiB for 21 remaining style-reference slots at a provisional 5.8 MiB mean; measured sizes vary by duration and encoding.
